_comment: Known divergences from the specification. Remove an entry when you fix it; move it to "accepted" with a reason when it is deliberate. Regenerate with: php bin/spec-audit --write-baseline

open.callOutcomes:filter.flag:supportsFilteri: $supportsFiltering is true but `callOutcomes.list` does not declare a filter object.
open.callOutcomes:filter.phantom:ids: Advertises filter `ids`; `callOutcomes.list` does not declare it, so the API ignores it and returns everything.
open.departments:include.flag:supportsSideloa: $supportsSideloading is true but neither `.list` nor `.info` declares includes.
open.departments:pagination.flag:supportsPagi: $supportsPagination is true but `departments.list` does not declare page.
open.departments:sort.missing:created_at: `departments.list` declares sort field `created_at`; the resource does not advertise it.
open.departments:sort.missing:default_departm: `departments.list` declares sort field `default_department`; the resource does not advertise it.
open.departments:sort.missing:name: `departments.list` declares sort field `name`; the resource does not advertise it.
open.documentTemplates:include.flag:supportsS: $supportsSideloading is true but neither `.list` nor `.info` declares includes.
open.documentTemplates:sort.flag:supportsSort: $supportsSorting is true but `documentTemplates.list` does not declare sort.
open.meetings:sort.missing:scheduled_at: `meetings.list` declares sort field `scheduled_at`; the resource does not advertise it.
open.plannableItems:filter.missing:types: `plannableItems.list` declares filter `types` (array of string, enum: closingDay|dayOffType|meeting|task|call|externalEvent); the resource does not advertise it.
open.plannableItems:filter.phantom:status: Advertises filter `status`; `plannableItems.list` does not declare it, so the API ignores it and returns everything.
open.products:include.phantom:custom_fields: Advertises include `custom_fields`; the specification names only: suppliers. Verify before removing.
open.reservations:filter.missing:project_ids: `reservations.list` declares filter `project_ids` (array of string); the resource does not advertise it.
open.reservations:filter.missing:term: `reservations.list` declares filter `term` (string); the resource does not advertise it.
open.reservations:filter.missing:work_type_id: `reservations.list` declares filter `work_type_ids` (array of string); the resource does not advertise it.
open.teams:sort.missing:name: `teams.list` declares sort field `name`; the resource does not advertise it.
open.tickets:filter.missing:assignee_ids: `tickets.list` declares filter `assignee_ids` (array of string, nullable); the resource does not advertise it.
open.timers:example.method:update_current:tim: Usage example `update_current` calls `timers()->update()`, which does not exist on Timers.
open.users:endpoint.deprecated:users.getWeekS: Calls `users.getWeekSchedule`, which the specification marks as deprecated.
open.users:include.shape:availableIncludes: $availableIncludes is a keyed map; every resource must declare a flat list so getCapabilities() has one shape.
open.users:sort.missing:email: `users.list` declares sort field `email`; the resource does not advertise it.
open.users:sort.missing:first_name: `users.list` declares sort field `first_name`; the resource does not advertise it.
open.users:sort.missing:function: `users.list` declares sort field `function`; the resource does not advertise it.
open.users:sort.missing:last_name: `users.list` declares sort field `last_name`; the resource does not advertise it.
open.workTypes:sort.flag:supportsSorting: $supportsSorting is true but `workTypes.list` does not declare sort.
